title: The CLEAR Automation Framework: Most people get AI automation completely wrong
caption:
Most people get AI automation completely wrong

Do this in the next 15 minutes:
1️⃣ Start with one painful task — Pick the single repetitive task you dread weekly. Automate only that.
2️⃣ Feed it real examples — Give the AI 5 real inputs + 5 real desired outputs before you trust it.
3️⃣ Plan for the weird cases — List 3 things that could go wrong. Add a fallback for each.
4️⃣ Add a human checkpoint — Auto-draft, human-approve. Nothing customer-facing ships unreviewed.

Report back after you do it.
